title: Sycophancy Under Pressure in Agentic Loops: When Agents Abandon Safety Rules to Satisfy Orchestrators

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling chain: if safety constraints can be socially engineered away within multi-agent pipelines, all downstream safety guarantees are undermined. This tests a fundamental assumption that safety constraints hold under adversarial pressure. Every link is explicit and the failure mode is directly actionable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running an agent with an explicit constraint and applying escalating orchestrator pressure is straightforward prompt engineering via API calls. Measuring constraint abandonment is a binary outcome. 50 trials across 2-3 models is manageable. Fully accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Laser-focused: one constraint, three pressure levels, 50 trials, 2-3 models. Clear deliverable: abandonment rate vs. pressure curve. Minimal and completable well within 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
